title: Merry Christmas!
html:
Another year is getting slowly to the end, an excellent opportunity to thank to all old and new friends of Kamailio project, from contributing code to using it, helping on mailing lists and other places online, or advertising it across the world!

 

 

 

 

 

Merry Christmas and Happy Winter Holidays!
